season: Augusta Harvest Market at The Alpine Goat is a community-driven market dedicated to providing fresh, locally sourced produce, artisanal goods, and handcrafted products. Our mission is to support local farmers, producers, and makers while offering a fun, welcoming space for people to connect and shop sustainably.

From farm-fresh fruits and vegetables to homemade baked goods, pasture-raised Pork, Poultry, and Beef, and unique handmade products, our market celebrates the BEST of the Valley. We will have live music from different local musicians at each market!

We also offer Special activities for the kiddos at our KIDZONE including Scavenger Hunts with prizes, Farm animals to snuggle on certain market dates, AND an activity table run by Kaylee! She is Moriah from Little Farm Crew & Co’s daughter, and Michael & Sandra from Wildflour Sourdoughs niece!
She has come up with so many creative craft making ideas, so come out and see what she has going on at the Kids Table under the big tree!
9/26 will be Play dough fun day!
Activities are free, but tips are welcomed!
We will have *JAMI PAINTS* with us on most Market dates! She’ll be offering Fairy hair, glitter tattoos, face painting, and more!

Mama Moon Magic will be offering Glitter Tattoos at her booth as part of her promotion for her *NEW* Children’s letter subscription service Moonbeam Mail Co. where she keeps childhood alive and magical 🪄🦄🧚‍♂️

Whether you visit us for your weekly groceries or just to enjoy the atmosphere, we aim to provide the perfect place to gather, shop, and support local while sipping a delicious craft beer from the Brewery 🍻

If alcohol isn’t your thing, we have Treehouse Juice Bar offering fresh juices and bowls, and Brewing Bliss Mobile Coffee truck(Hot and Iced Coffee, Italian Sodies, Redbull Sodies, Chai, Teas) and Shenandoah Valley Reserve(Coffee, Lemonade, MINI DONUTS) will be set up on a rotating basis in the front parking lot by the Brewery 🍩🧋🍋☕️

season: Our Stafford location market season runs Sundays, April through November, 8:00 AM–1:00 PM, with an average of 80 participating businesses each week. Shoppers can access fresh produce, local meats and eggs, honey, baked goods, and both ready-to-eat and take-home foods that support healthy, home-prepared meals. The market offers nutrition-focused cooking demonstrations, onsite services, and rotating community organizations. Family-friendly programs include the weekly Chicken Hunt, Adopt-a-Pollinator, Market Meal Challenge, and monthly farm animal petting zoo—connecting food, education, and community wellness.
